paragraphs.text: Mathas , Fiend Seeker is a legendary vampire from an unknown plane .

He is both a vampire and a vampire hunter. Mathas' desire to be the only one of his kind drives him to betray his brethren. He hunts his fellow vampires and brands them with a powerful holy symbol, condemning them to death.
Mathas keeps his true identity a secret, playing the part of an innocent mortal, but with every death, he comes one step closer to the time he will finally be able to unleash his hunger on the world.
